$comment: The license policy (tools/license-policy.ts). Only the CI role may change this file (.github/CODEOWNERS). allowedLicenses are accepted without asking; an SPDX 'A OR B' expression is accepted when any alternative is, 'A AND B' when every part is. Anything else — copyleft, commercial, unknown, or no license at all ('(none)') — fails `pnpm run licenses:check` until an entry in approvals admits that one package under that exact license. An approval names the package (a trailing * matches platform builds), the license exactly as declared, the scope (distributed covers development too; development: used only while developing and testing; external: a program a bridge runs as a separate process) and the reason a reviewer accepted it. A changed license voids the approval; an approval nothing matches any more fails the check as stale.

approvals.reason: bridges/signal-bridge runs a separately installed signal-cli as its own process over its command line and JSON-RPC interface; nothing in this repository links, copies or ships it (THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md).
Part of signal-cli's own distribution, never linked or shipped by this repository; covered by the same separate-process boundary as signal-cli.
bridges/email-bridge runs the user's own installed gpg as a separate program, for PGP-enabled documents only; nothing in this repository links or ships it.
